Hi Samantha / Alex —

Thanks for the intro call yesterday. Attached is a first-draft Mutual Action Plan (Orion_MAP_v1.xlsx) and a short launch playbook that lays out milestone dates, primary owners, and required deliverables for a July pilot. High-level asks (please confirm by EOD Wed):

- Confirm sandbox target date (proposed: 2026-06-28) and who will own credentials on your side (Alex or infra team)
- Approve the milestone owners in the attached sheet or propose changes
- Flag any procurement/contract steps that will block access or data sharing

Summary of the initial milestones (see spreadsheet for detail):
- Week 0 (Jun 28): Sandbox provisioned and access validated — Owner: Orion (Alex) / Redwood infra (Dev)
- Week 1 (Jul 5): Data ingestion proof-of-concept (small test set) — Owner: Orion data lead / Redwood CS (Marissa)
- Week 2 (Jul 12): Integration + basic inference tests — Owner: Redwood Eng (Karthik) / Orion dev
- Week 4 (Jul 26): Pilot go/no-go review and success criteria sign-off — Owner: Orion PM / Redwood AE (Lauren)

Attachments: Orion_MAP_v1.xlsx (milestones, owners, acceptance criteria) and Sandbox_Access_Instructions.pdf (env checklist).

I've looped in Marissa (CS lead) and Dev (technical PM) to own onboarding and infra prep. If you want a more detailed runbook for any milestone we can add it as separate “sprint” tabs in the workbook.

Next steps: please confirm sandbox date and procurement contacts, and we’ll lock calendar invites for the kickoff session.

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop

Hi Samantha + team —

Jun 29 kickoff works for me; I’ll send a calendar invite for 60 minutes and share an internal pre-call checklist. A few clarifications / changes I made in the attached revised MAP (summary below):

- Sandbox provisioning: Move the internal validation window to Jun 26 (Dev will provision by Jun 25; we validate Jun 26) — Owner: Alex (Orion) / Dev (Redwood)
- Data ingestion POC: add acceptance criteria — sample throughput (100 req/s), sample size (2k rows), and schema mapping sign-off — Owner: Orion data lead / Marissa (CS)
- Integration tests: Karthik to lead Redwood-side validation scripts; request Orion to provide API keys + sample call flows by Jul 6
- Pilot sign-off: change review to Jul 27 (one day after internal pilot completion)

Action items for Orion ahead of kickoff:
1) Confirm service account owner and provide test creds by Jun 25
2) Share a sanitized sample dataset (2k rows) and example API call pattern by Jul 2
3) Confirm the internal stakeholders who will do acceptance (names & emails)

I attached the updated spreadsheet (Orion_MAP_v1.1.xlsx) with the revised dates and added a simple RACI column. Please confirm or suggest edits in the doc; I’ll lock the plan after the kickoff.

Regards,
